entities.summary: Michael Mario Lewis is an Israeli actor and fashion model. From 2007 to 2008, Lewis modeled for the Israeli clothing company Fox, with Esti Ginzburg. He appeared in fashion shows for Castro, and has been on the cover of several Israeli magazines.
